summary: Iteration 2 (Plum Peach) full-stack testing PASSED. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass — health, POST /api/scores (basic, empty/whitespace/missing-name -> 'Guest' default (English, no longer Japanese), 16-char truncation, negative clamp, create->GET-top persistence), GET /api/scores/top (sort desc, limit clamp, no _id leak), GET /api/scores/rank (shape, high-score=1, missing-param 422). Frontend (mobile 375x667 web preview): title-screen loads with 'Plum Peach' / 'FRUIT REACTION GAME' / BEST / PLAY / HOW TO PLAY / RANKING. Howto/Ranking navigation and back work; ranking loads existing rows. Game screen renders SCORE, SPEED meter, PEACH & PLUM buttons and falling FallingField. gameover-overlay auto-triggers on a miss (~1–2s of inactivity) with all English labels (GAME OVER, BEST, SAVE, RETRY, HOME, RANKING) and Name placeholder. Score submit -> 'Submitted to ranking!' and row appears in /api/scores/top (verified via curl: TEST_PLYW row present). retry-button dismisses overlay and resets score to 0. Wrong/rapid taps trigger game over as expected. No Japanese characters detected on title, howto, game, or overlay. No red-screen or console errors.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED (small typo, done by testing agent): game.tsx line 243 used LABELS[type].jp which does not exist in theme.ts (only .en is defined). Buttons rendered blank labels. Renamed to LABELS[type].en — PEACH/PLUM now render correctly. This was the only blocking migration miss.
theme.ts still exports unused durationForScore() from the old timed-per-fruit mechanic — safe to remove.
game.tsx still keeps unused old styles (lane/string/stack/bead/targetBead/catchLine) after the FallingField refactor — safe to remove for clarity.
Backend ScoreCreate validators correctly default empty/whitespace name to 'Guest' (English) and clamp negatives to 0; response excludes mongo _id via projection.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; every interactive element has testID; all text is wrapped in <Text>; StyleSheet.create used throughout.
FallingField requestAnimationFrame loop correctly cancels on unmount and on game-over via stop().
